description: The empty-model warning links directly to the add form. The page starts with no models at all and a hint to add one. The screen is the default phone. Name elements by ARIA role and accessible name, as Playwright's getByRole does. "The hint" is ".no-models-message"; "the action" is the hint's button named exactly "Click here to add models"; "the title" is the hint's ".no-models-title". Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /new. 2. The hint must contain neither "Ctrl" nor "⌘". 3. The action's computed text-decoration-line should be "underline" and its computed overflow "visible". 4. Set the viewport to 1280x800 (width and height only). Using the bounding boxes of the title and the action: the action's x must be greater than the title's x + width (the link follows the title on its line), and |action y - title y| must be less than 10. 5. Set the viewport to 412x800 (width and height only). The title's computed text-align should be "center"; the action's y must be at least the title's y + height (the link goes below it), and the horizontal centers of the action and the title (x + width / 2) must differ by less than 1. 6. Click the action. The element with data-testid "model-provider-form" should be visible, and data-testid "model-mode-provider" should have aria-pressed="true".

steps.expression: (() => { const title = document.querySelector('.no-models-title').getBoundingClientRect(); const action = document.querySelector('.no-models-message button').getBoundingClientRect(); return action.x > title.x + title.width; })()

(() => { const title = document.querySelector('.no-models-title').getBoundingClientRect(); const action = document.querySelector('.no-models-message button').getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.abs(action.y - title.y) < 10; })()

(() => { const title = document.querySelector('.no-models-title').getBoundingClientRect(); const action = document.querySelector('.no-models-message button').getBoundingClientRect(); return action.y >= title.y + title.height; })()
